title: Spot Goes to Hollywood
native_title: スポット・ゴーズ・トゥー・ハリウッド
overview:
The 7UP character Spot's action-packed adventure!

Spot, the cool red mascot of 7UP, gets pulled into a movie projector and has to fight his way out of one film after another. Guide him through isometric movie-themed worlds, from the deck of a pirate ship onward, running, jumping and firing his unlimited hot shot at the enemies in his way.

- Each level is a run to the exit, packed with hidden rooms to explore
- Collect Spot Dots for extra lives and hunt down five hidden Golden Stars per level to open bonus stages
- Pick up special weapons with limited shots, and push, pull and shoot open objects for bonus items
- Three control schemes, including an arcade-style option

7UPのキャラクター、スポットの冒険活劇！！
